datum: Alleluia, * alleluia, alleluia.
Unto the King Eternal, Immortal and Invisible, + the only God, be honour and glory * for ever and ever. Amen.

incipit: Thou Son of the Living God,
versus: Thou That sittest at the right hand of the Father.
Thou That art to come into the world.

incipit: Thou Son of the Living God, have mercy on us
versus: Thou that art arisen from the dead.

datum: Thou that wast born of the Virgin Mary.
Thou That art manifested unto us this day.
Thou that art gone up above the stars.
Thou that didst suffer for us.
Thou that sittest at the right hand of the Father.
V. Arise, O Christ, and help us.
R. And deliver us for Thy Name's sake.
in-tempore-paschali: V. Arise, O Christ, and help us, Alleluia.
R. And deliver us for Thy Name's sake, Alleluia.

datum: Kyrie eleison. Christe eleison. Kyrie eleison.
V. And unto Thee have I cries, O Lord.
R. And in the morning shall my prayer come betimes before Thee.
V. Let my mouth be filled with Thy praise.
R. That I may sing of Thy glory, all the day long of Thy greatness.
V. O Lord, hide Thy face from my sins.
R. And blot out all mine iniquities.
V. Create in me a clean heart, O God.
R. And renew a right spirit within me.
V. Cast me not away from Thy presence.
R. And take not Thine holy Spirit from me.
V. Restore unto me the joy of Thy salvation.
R. And uphold me with Thy free spirit.
V. Vouchsafe, O Lord, this day.
R. To keep us without sin.
V. Have mercy upon us, O Lord.
R. Have mercy upon us.
V. O Lord, let Thy mercy lighten upon us.
R. As our trust is in Thee.

O Lord God Almighty, Who hast safely brought us to the beginning of this day, + defend us in the same with Thy mighty power: and grant that this day we fall into no sin, but that all Our thoughts, words, * and works may be ordered by Thy governance to do always that is righteous in Thy sight.
Alleluia, * alleluia, alleluia, alleluia.
Blessed are they that walk * in Thy law, O Lord.
As I live, * saith the Lord, I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked, but rather that he turn from his way and live.
Deliver me, O Lord, * and set me beside Thee: and any man's hand may fight against me.
Love peace and truth, * saith the Lord Almighty.
